question: Which bīja syllables are ritually assigned to the little fingers and the palms?
premises: The bīja syllable krau is assigned to the pair of little fingers.
The bīja syllable kraḥ is assigned to the palm surface.
The word tathā indicates continuation of the preceding placement pattern.
inference: The nyāsa sequence continues by placing krau on the little fingers and kraḥ on the palms.
uncertainties: karatale is singular in form but may contextually imply both palms.
plain_english: Place oṃ krau on the pair of little fingers, and likewise place oṃ kraḥ on the palms.
